id: title:dmarchuk:send a broadcast from a cohort

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a broadcast email action to the cohort editing UI, potentially enabling users to trigger cohort-specific broadcasts, though backend implementation and complete workflow are not shown.
review.reason: Adds a frontend button and menu item for sending broadcast emails to a cohort, but the chunk lacks the backend implementation and complete workflow, preventing a higher tier assessment.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned conservatively as a UI change, but the lack of backend implementation and complete workflow prevents establishing a tier of 2 or 3. The actual benefit and reliability depend on unshown backend support.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the broadcast workflow, the MessageAudience component, or the backend changes. It only shows the frontend UI and the cohort-specific checks. The tier cannot be established without seeing the complete workflow and backend support.

observations.behavior: Adds a new button and menu item to send a broadcast email to a cohort.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a broadcast action to cohort editing and menu, but the implementation and backend support are not shown in this chunk.
